replies.author: @HiddenCanada
replies.text: Yep, that’s actually what the video finds. None of these locations are currently censored in direct overhead satellite imagery. The point was to check the online claims and see which ones held up. Most didn’t. A few had older or different map layers that looked restricted, and Baker Lake had that unexplained black strip, but current imagery is visible.
